business_summary.text: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited is an integrated renewable energy company engaged in EPC, O&M, and manufacturing of solar modules and BESS systems.

call_points.text: 1.2 GW solar cell facility targeted for commercial operations by June 2027
EBITDA margin declined to 11.6% in Q1FY27 due to higher execution costs

penalties.authority: Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
penalties.details: The Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi, imposed a penalty of ₹5,000 for non-payment of stamp duty under the applicable provisions of the Indian Stamp Act, 1899 as applicable to the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
penalties.impact: There is no material impact on the financial position, operations or other activities of the Company.

tax_litigation.opposing_party: Directorate of Revenue Inteligence (DRI), Regional Unit, Thiruvananathpuram
tax_litigation.status: Closed vide Investigation Closure letter dated 25-Jun-2026 issued by Office of Commissioner of Customs (NS-V)
